parameters.negative_prompt: news broadcast, stock footage, advertisement, 3d animation, computer graphics, cartoon, watermark, logo, text, on screen text, subtitles, titles, signature, slow motion, dramatic reaction, handshake, contract signing, celebration, distorted face, distorted hands, extra fingers

response.prompt: Animate this reference into an eight-second, 16:9 photorealistic cinematic live-action shot in a quiet observational documentary style. Preserve the same competent woman owner in her late fifties on the left, the same thoughtful male buyer in his early forties on the right, their clothing, the worn wooden table, the workshop office, and the natural late-afternoon light. Both people remain silent with no visible speech. Use only restrained natural movement: breathing, one or two blinks, the owner gently relaxing and resettling her fingers, and the buyer making a very small listening nod. The camera makes one subtle, steady dolly toward the table, as if operated by a documentary camera person standing in the doorway. Keep faces, eyes, hands, clothing, furniture, windows, and room geometry stable and realistic. Maintain warm ledger-paper neutrals, deep mineral teal, natural skin, shallow depth of field, and a clearly visible horizontal table edge across the lower third by the final second. No dialogue, lip movement, logos, readable documents, contract, sale, price, handshake, agreement, celebration, confusion, or dramatic reaction. Quiet documentary film, not an advertisement.
